notes: Covered: Zagreb city + Velika Gorica/Zaprešić/Samobor, Split/Sinj/Trogir, Rijeka + Opatija/Krk/Mali Lošinj, Istria (Pula, Rovinj, Žminj, Umag, Poreč, Buje, Buzet), Osijek, Zadar, Šibenik, Dubrovnik, Varaždin, Karlovac, Slavonski Brod, Koprivnica, Bjelovar, Vinkovci, Vukovar, Čakovec, Gospić, Sisak area. Duty rotas: no official city/county 'dežurstvo veterinara' rota was found anywhere in Croatia; Hrvatska veterinarska komora (hvk.hr) register did not surface in search and was not opened. In Zagreb the city-owned Veterinarska stanica Grada Zagreba sends all out-of-hours cases to the private Buba clinic (060 600 100); the university hospital (VEF) takes emergencies 0-24 walk-in. A 2025 SiB.hr article says Osijek has no formal shifts - each practice runs its own standby. Karlovac (VS Karlovac) has 0-24 duty on Sundays/holidays only. Poison line: none for animals exists that we could find; the IMI Centar za kontrolu otrovanja (+385 1 2348 342, 0-24) is a human poison centre and its pages do not mention animals - vets are the first call. Blocked/unfetchable: veterinarska.hr/pripravnost, vetvision.hr (robots), zoo-vet.hr (robots), veterina-porec.com (robots), veterinari-crikvenica.hr (robots), vaistravet.hr and mustac-vet.hr (redirect loop), veto-doo.hr, mnovine.hr dežurni veterinari (Makarska), korculainfo.com, vetti-group.hr (robots), porec.hr servisne informacije. Klinika Kreszinger now redirects to vetti-buba.hr (not listed separately). Follow-up run 2026-10-31: Covered: Zagreb extras (Vet svijet, Veterina Branimir x2, Ljubimac, Galavet, Kreszinger, Dugo Selo, Novo Brestje, Dodo-Vet). Dalmatia: Hvar (Hvar town, Stari Grad x2), Brač/Supetar, Korčula/Vela Luka, Omiš (Šestanovac seat), Kaštela, Solin, Split extras (Pilić, Anima, Filipović), Imotski, Vodice (24h), Šibenik Gardijan, Zadar (Bokanjac 24h, Žilić), Pag x2, Dubrovnik Fauna, Konavle/Gruda.
